name: aside-jot
description: The aside skill for Claude Code: read and act on jots saved with `>>`.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Read and act on your aside jots: check the inbox, find where you worked, and "update jot N" to see whether a jot was done. Needs aside 0.4.0 or later installed, `aside setup claude` run (the hook that records jots), and the aside MCP server added (this release of the skill takes the path to aside from its tool descriptions).
